Folder.comment: A workspace Folder — mdoc:Folder, one per folder. Code-defined span (rdf_workspace_entity_triples::push_folder_snapshot_triples). DERIVED flat. order is xsd:float (push_workspace_number_triple).

TipTapDocument.comment: A workspace document entry — mdoc:TipTapDocument. Code-defined span (push_document_snapshot_triples). DERIVED flat. The doc-entry metadata face (title/order/parent + optional source-file predicates); sourceContentSize is xsd:integer.

Artifact.comment: A workspace Artifact — mdoc:Artifact PLUS a dual kind-class type (mdoc:Image/mdoc:Pdf/...). Code-defined span (push_artifact_snapshot_triples). DERIVED flat. The kind-class rdf:type is permitted by the closed shape (rdf:type is ignored). order is xsd:float; fileSize is xsd:integer.

mdoc:sceneProjection.comment: link to the artifact's SceneProjection root (when a scene is attached)

comment: EA-2b+ SHACL retrofit contract for the WORKSPACE Meaningful Object (structural fork: a MULTI-CLASS union + a once-at-seed rdfs:subClassOf ontology block). NOT a served emporium pack — an AUTHORED mirror of the code-defined workspace_entity_triples span, whose sole consumer is vocab_to_shacl. SCOPE: this contract declares the 3 MDOC-NAMESPACED ENTITY classes (Folder/TipTapDocument/Artifact), each an independent flat closed sh:NodeShape — the multi-class union (already supported, no emitter change). The 4th entity class WIRE (wire:Wire, in WIRE_NS not MDOC_NS) is OUT of this contract: the emitter targets only primary-namespace (mdoc:) rdf_types, and wire:Wire is the same span as the standalone WIRES kind — it has its OWN dedicated contract (emporium-wires.golden.json) and oracle, and the wire oracle's equivalence test proves the workspace-composed Wire span == the standalone Wire span. The 6 SCENE classes (mdoc:SceneProjection/SceneAnchor/SceneFrame/SceneText/SceneWireCandidate/SceneDiagnostic) share the SAME flat derivation and are surveyed first-class by the reconcile path; they are LEFT OUT here to keep the oracle tight (their many conditionally-emitted attribute predicates would bloat a closed shape) — a deliberate scope choice, documented, not a gap in the method. The ONTOLOGY BLOCK (mdoc:Image rdfs:subClassOf mdoc:Artifact + capability triples, subjects are CLASS IRIs with NO rdf:type) is SHACL-INEXPRESSIBLE in this instance-shape model (no instance targets a class-level subject) and is a once-at-seed idempotent INSERT (seed_ontology_block) — the honest hand-authored complement, NOT silently skipped (the oracle asserts the subclass triples are present + outside the reconcile diff).
description: A workspace projection: a multi-class union of Folder, TipTapDocument, and Artifact (dual kind-typed) entities, over a once-seeded artifact-kind subclass ontology.
